subject: general
question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 5.
solution:
The correct answer is '**but**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The conjunction "**but**" is used to introduce a phrase or clause contrasting with what has been previously mentioned. It fits well in the context of the sentence, which contrasts tigers being slow runners with another aspect of their physical capability.
 
• The sentence structure implies a contrast between two statements: tigers being slow runners and being good swimmers. "**But**" is the most suitable option to connect these contrasting ideas.
 
• Using "**but**" emphasizes the surprising or unexpected nature of the second part of the sentence, which is a common usage of this conjunction.
 
• The presence of "**but**" helps balance out the sentence by showing that despite a limitation (being slow runners), tigers have a compensatory strength (being good swimmers).

Therefore, the correct answer is ‘**Option 1**’.

 

Complete Passage: *The white tiger is an offspring of Bengal tiger, which has the necessary gene for white colouring. It has beautiful black stripes on the__ white coat. __This__ species of animal has blue eyes and a pink nose.*

*A pure white tiger is totally white without any stripes, which is due to the presence of double recessive allele in the genetic code. It happens only in the Bengal tiger subspecies, and only one in 10,000 births can have it naturally. White tigers are rarely seen in the wild, and only twelve of them have been spotted in India __in__ the last one-hundred years. Tigers have a lifespan of 10-15 years. They are __solitary__ animals, and are fond of hunting at night. Their diet consists of any animals that they can catch, and can eat up to 40 pounds of meat at one time. After such a big meal, they usually remain away for several days from food. They are slow runners, __but__ good swimmers. They are poor climbers and cannot climb a tree easily. They live in an area ranging from 10 to 30 square miles depending upon the availability of prey, water and shelter. Habitat loss, poaching and expansion of the human population have together contributed to their becoming endangered. They are widely hunted for their body-parts, which are used in traditional Chinese medicines.*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• "**Either**" is used to indicate a choice between two possibilities and does not fit the context of contrasting statements.
 
• "**Nor**" is used in negative structures to introduce an additional negative point; however, the sentence structure does not support its use because the second part of the sentence is not negative.
 
• "**Or**" suggests an alternative or choice between two options but does not convey the contrast intended in the original sentence.
